name: security_admin_action_failures
description: Failed privileged operations (user.role_changed / user.banned / user.unbanned security events with outcome=failure), emitted by SecurityEventLogger via the auth.ts hooks.after hook.
filter: jsonPayload.meta.eventCategory="security" AND jsonPayload.message=("user.role_changed" OR "user.banned" OR "user.unbanned") AND jsonPayload.meta.outcome="failure"
